Method of Attack: Malware embedded in the package, base64 encoded; creating and running an executable file on Windows-type systems; creating a malicious scheduled task; data exfiltration; using obfuscation and evasion techniques; maintaining communication with multiple C2 servers; running a local HTTP server for incoming commands; manipulating files and directories; obfuscating communication channels using Tor network; implementing anti-debugging and anti-virtualization measures.
Attack Vector: Distributing the malware through packages in PyPI repository
